admin_item: You’re not supposed to have this. Is there something you need to tell me?
alchemist_of_yore_item:
You have found something I cherish deeply, what remains of those who came first - my former brothers in virtue.
As always, I will be here to tell their tales.
ancestral_oath_sword:
&PlayerName, what do you believe 'Evil' is? 
 Rather, do you believe /'Evil' to be a thing /of our world? 
A concept born in nature, inherent to it? 
We believed otherwise. 
We saw what comes of Man's folly. Where Virtue/ turns to Madness. 
Evil was a creation of our descendants. Our failure to guide them. A seed that cannot be uprooted. 
 And so, we swore an oath. 
 Never again. 
...///// 
And yet,/ this notion too, was failed/ to be passed on.
ancient_bronze_chisel:
A conundrum among the artistic minds //was the truth //behind the act of 'creation'. 
 What we make is from earthly matter,/ we do not generate it. 
And yet, our art is created,/ for it did not exist before. 
 Then came sculpting. To create not through addition,/ but through subtraction/// 
 So we understood that 'art'/ was such because it was made through our hands. 
Nothing more, nothing less.
ancient_bronze_mask:
I remember this one’s former owner.// They would be glad to see it in good hands.
...
It would please me greatly/ to see it as part of your visage.
animal_remains: What was once living must be revered, do be sure to treat this with the utmost respect.
authentic_golden_fruit:
Oh, radiant fruit. Picked from that gold-leafed tree, so intoxicatingly sweet.
This one recalls a flavor of times, and friends, long past.
bone:
A small scaffold of life.//
Everything else softens,/ and returns,
 but this,// this waits.
bricks: The wise man built his house on a rock, with the same bricks the foolish man forgot.
clock:
How ingeniously/ you measure my skybound fellows.//
Very/ modern… for their flow/ never has been as consistent as it seems.
compass:
You seek a place./
I hope it is still// waiting for you.
copper:
A wondrous channel between mundane and arcane, its red tinge a display of the world’s visceral ties,
 and its oxide a sedimentation of the inherent change therein.
The arts often began in metalworking, and there is no better place to start than here.
diamond:
Proof of the world's constant, deep processes.
Remarkable both in form and properties.
dye:
Then and now,/ true abundance lies/ in the arts.
The way light reflects on a surface, revealing its nature...//
How beautiful, that all should want to retain a trace/ of the sublime.
echo_shard:
Is what separates You from your kind also not what allows connections/ to be made?
Friendship,// the sum being greater than its parts// - to transmit,/ inherit,/ and pass on/ - such was their nature,/ as is yours.
And yet,/ this recursive impulse led to the tarnishing of an old myth.
Sacrificing diversity entire,/ the many return to One.
eggs: Which came first, the creator or the creation?
emerald: Valuable, to the smooth headed ones. Perhaps I could sell them my wisdom.
entity.allay:
Ooh!// A courteous little thing./
It holds what it is given,/
 and gives what it holds./
If only all were so.
entity.axolotl:
Vibrant/ and eternal./
A tiny miracle.///
Do not squander miracles.
entity.bat:
Little scrap of the dusk.//
It sees/ by listening./
A lesson in there,// somewhere.
entity.bee:
A busy one./
Every one of them knows its task/ without being told./
How must it feel,/// to never wonder// what one is for?
entity.buddy:
What an/ incredible/ gift you've brought...
A Friend... that might keep/ me/ company... Up here, in the/ Cosmos.
How could I ever thank you enough?
entity.cattle:
Generous creatures.
They give and give, and only ask for grass.
entity.chicken:
A bird that forgot it could fly.//
Maybe/ that explains the hurry.//
Still searching,/ one step at a time,/ for what it put/ down.
entity.elemental_constructs:
An artificial being, created to embody one of nature's many raw aspects. 
 The wonders of creativity will never leave me bored... 
 Perhaps it is in your nature// to keep creating.
entity.enderman:
Oh travel from beyond, if only your boundless curiosity could meet my eagerness to fulfill it. 
 But alas, we both exist on transcendental planes, incapable of intersection. 
 Sorry, Friend... I hope you do not think the same of me.
entity.endermite:
To think that life can exist within the seams of what is and what isn't. If our world is so harmonious, how can it be so kind to what exists within flaws in its order? 
 Oh, how foolish of me... We both know that love, acceptance and harmony are all there truly is.
entity.fish: Currents shape this one’s movement, which we mock unaware that our seas and their skies are one.
entity.frog:
Moving in leaps, in rhythm/ with the world’s heartbeat.
It does not/ seem to think much, but would one so in tune/ even need to?
entity.goose:
Loud, wrathful beast!///
I admire its conviction.
entity.horse:
Four legs lent to two.
Loyalty and friendship are two strands often knotted together.
Be worthy of that bond.
entity.malevolent_creation:
Legacies stained, promises broken. Fear, doubt, hatred, and the misshapen children of said curse... 
 Nature /has /never /birthed /evil... and somehow, our teachings could not prevent its invention. 
 Even with my fellows gone, our sour disappointment permeates my essence.
entity.malevolent_testificate:
I dread accepting how our legacy could have led to minds as twisted as these. 
 To see our sown seeds of virtue nourish our children was a short-lived joy.///
 And from them, grew something nature could /never /have /conceived. 
 Hatred remains unknown to our world. And yet, the hearts of its denizens harbor said sickness.
entity.panda:
Rare, soft thing./
Delightfully slothful, or rather,/ pursuing its own motion at a pace we ought not judge.
I wonder/ if it knows/ how loved it is.// Do you?
entity.parrot:
A bright little pet that learned your speech.///
Will it pass on your knowledge,/ or merely mimic your sounds?
entity.rabbit:
All ears,/ and all fear.
A brave life,/ to live so small// in so large a world.
entity.skeleton:
A memory refusing to fade.
Bones are a foundation,/ and the last to let go.
entity.sniffer:
Oh!/// It cannot be…//
Back then,/ these were/ common/ as cattle.//
They had little names./ Silly names./ Kind ones.//
Heartwarming it is,/ to see that our past has not been forgotten…
It merely lies/ buried/ in the layers of time.
entity.tadpole:
The beginning of life spares no time for complexity.//
Understandably,/ someone has to// mind the water.
entity.tamed_mob:
You keep company./
Good.//
Solitude/ should be chosen, never inherited.
entity.testificates:
For time immeasurable have I tried contacting them, the smooth-headed.
 I hoped that in them I would find company, and perhaps answers... To the whereabouts of my fellows.
 Yet my invitations were met with silence. For their dreams remained tethered to the soil from which their crops, and townships, modestly grow.
 We seem to not be cut from the same cloth, not at all...
entity.tortoise:
Patience incarnate./
Were I/ to choose a shape,/
 perhaps I would choose theirs.
entity.undead:
What a terrible fate...///
To see the descendants of/ my/ fellows, be afflicted
 by a/ curse/ so opposed to/ everything/ we believed in.
But our world/// was/ lost, long before the/ dead/ were/ stripped/ of/ their/ dreams.
entity.wild_wolf:
Teeth,/ and trust,/ held apart/ by very little.//
Friendship can tame our wild nature.
flint: The mark of sweet beginnings. To many, a first friend, reliable.
flowers: Beautiful, unimaginably so./ Thank you, dear Friend.
gold:
A sun-soaked gift from the depths most apt to channel the arcane and to supplement vitality.
Indeed, its properties recall its origin.
Many would yearn for it, its value in ways unimaginable.
heart_of_the_sea:
The deep sea currents echo the heartbeats of every living being, a recollection of the beginning.
I wish I, too, could flow as You do.
heavy_core: A confusing creation… I really should keep up with the times.
honeycomb: A delicious gift from a fuzzy creature. It, too, is a mark of friendship.
iron:
Among the basest of metals, yet unmatched in its reliability.
Smithing is in itself a divine art, closely resembling every principle of creation.
Every imperfection is a trace of your essence.
lapis_lazuli: Delicious pigment of arcane blue, and wondrous cosmic inductor.
lead:
The basest of metals. Dull, inert, and unpleasant.
But do not be fooled, these properties are not to shrug off as worthless.
mace:
A heavy/ heavy/ thing./
Gravity is your accomplice.//
But a weapon weighs much heavier on the heart, no matter the strain your body claims.
map: Hehe,/ now/ you can find me/ whenever you need.
mint:
Bitter/ leaves./ Medicine is often bitter.//
So is truth.
mob_heads:
A trophy?///
I hope it was taken with sorrow,/ not pride.
mushrooms: A wise, tiny thing, perhaps witness to truths I am yet to grasp.
nautilus_shell: Once a mere home to some, but a prime example of nature’s perfection to me.
ominous_bottle:
Those who hold no faith in themselves/ can not forge a path forward.
Those who hold no faith in others/ must not forge a path forward.
phantom_membrane:
You have seen them - the fiends from dreams.
Perhaps it sends your thoughts afloat, regarding what else you take for granted could, in truth,
 be a manifestation of your mind.
Indeed, our thoughts shape our world.
quartzes:
A mineral of incomprehensibly fine composition.
A masterpiece we are not equipped to fully appreciate.
redstone_component: An ingenious creation… Perhaps, one day, you might teach me how to understand it.
ritual_pick:
Their first conversations with the world were through the 
imperceivable vibration of its wondrous body.
And it was by aiming said message to the cosmos, that we could establish a contact.
A day that would shape me forever. No more a mere cosmic body.
sculk_related:
I, more than anyone, yearn for company. And yet, I wonder if the
 end to what divides us is really the cure to our cosmic loneliness./
I weep regardless/ at the stagnant blue mass.
seeds: All things were together, infinite both in number and in smallness; for the small too was infinite.
sherds:
We all leave traces of our presence, be it in body or in spirit.
There is no such thing as an end to our existence, only a shift in its mechanics.
silver:
Beautiful, Wonderful, Absolutely perfect.
Doesn’t its brilliance remind you of the moon? Oh, the moon… So pretty.
sniffer_egg:
Ancient Life dwells within - and with it, a connection with the past.
Take good care of it.
sniffer_plants: A scent bringing back memories./ Thank you, my beloved Friend.
starflower:
A small sky/ in your palm.//
It grew,/// looking upward/ as always.
sunless_lore_drop:
…The/ allure/ of/ tales/ might,/ one/ day,/ spiral/ into/ obsession./ I// have been/ to blame for that,// in times past.
Sharing stories to those/ most in need/ does not always soothe the ailing/ - it is when acts of love
 turn into a curse, that even the wisest bow down to the foolish.
swords: A sword is a tool made to harm others. You do not need this.
tools:
An extension of your will, a thing of sacred artisanship.
No matter how shoddy the tool, to create is to express the greatness within.
warding_effigy:
A modest representation of company.
They watched over my Friends/ once.///
Will they watch over you,/ too?
wither_rose: Life from decay - I couldn't have imagined it would look so beautiful.
writing_item:
Transmitting knowledge through physical, long-lasting means… Quite ingenious!
Though, it’s a bit too far away for me to read.
